# gcore_cloud_quota (Data Source)

Quotas define the maximum amount of cloud resources (compute, storage, networking, GPU, and more) available to a client, both globally and per region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_quota" "example_cloud_quota" {

}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `global_quotas` (Attributes) Global entity quotas (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_quotas))
- `regional_quotas` (Attributes List) Regional entity quotas. Only contains initialized quotas. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regional_quotas))
